auth_type.correction: none for public read-only datasets; an optional Socrata app token identifies the application and increases throttling limits but is not necessarily authentication

free_tier_limits.correction: App-token requests currently have no fixed numeric limit unless abusive or malicious; tokenless requests use a lower shared IP-based pool whose numeric threshold is unpublished.

rate_limits.correction: Tokenless requests may be throttled based mainly on source IP; app-token requests are currently not throttled unless abusive or malicious, with HTTP 429 returned when throttled.

cors.correction: supported for read-only access to public datasets; Socrata drops authentication and authorization from CORS requests

notes: The service remains operational, but several metadata claims are stale or misclassified. Most importantly, tazs-3rd5 now documents cos-data.seattle.gov and SODA3, not the example's data.seattle.gov/resource URL. Current Socrata documentation also publishes throttling behavior and confirms CORS support.
